indicator_definition: This indicator measures the proportion of adults aged 18 and over classified as overweight or obese based on Body Mass Index (BMI). Overweight is defined as BMI ≥ 25 kg/m² and obesity as BMI ≥ 30 kg/m². It is expressed as a percentage of the adult population. Data are collected through the European Health Interview Survey (EHIS).
rationale: Overweight and obesity are major risk factors for non-communicable diseases including cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes and certain cancers. Rising obesity rates place significant burdens on healthcare systems and reduce healthy life expectancy. Progress means stabilising or reducing the prevalence of overweight and obesity.
methodology_characteristics: Data are collected through the European Health Interview Survey (EHIS), conducted approximately every five years. BMI is calculated from self-reported height and weight. EHIS follows a harmonised methodology across all participating countries, enabling cross-country comparisons.
indicator_name: Overweight and obesity rate in adults
